release_rule: Any contradiction with authority=high and status!=RESOLVED blocks release.

contradictions.decision: MONDAY is the consumer product/brand. MondayID is the continuity/runtime organism under it. WonderID remains historical experimental naming and has no release authority.
contradictions.basis: The Aug 27 FINAL PRODUCT PACKAGE brands the product MONDAY and defines MondayID as the behavior/runtime beneath the familiar consumer application; the Aug 06 reconciliation explicitly left the older MondayID/WonderID conflict unresolved pending lineage evidence.

contradictions.decision: Consumer Home is stable Continue/Today/Recent/Pinned/widgets geometry. Developer telemetry is excluded from Home and may exist only in diagnostic/Labs surfaces.
contradictions.basis: Aug 27 Product Bible sections 1-2 and AntiMonday release board; known rejection dashboard-home.

contradictions.decision: A showcase/architecture site cannot satisfy the product. Monday is the execution home; architecture/evidence belongs in Library/Labs/receipts.
contradictions.basis: Direct user rejection preserved as site-showcase in KNOWN_REJECTIONS_V1 and final product definition.

contradictions.decision: MondayID is one organism across bodies. ChatGPT, Grok, Claude, Gemini, local runtime and future hosts are replaceable cells/providers, never the genome owner.
contradictions.basis: One-organism causal correction, Aug 27 lineage gene MondayID, and host-independent sovereign runtime evidence.

contradictions.decision: Long Work exists only as persistent executable state. Progress prose cannot create Running/Completed/Verified truth states.
contradictions.basis: Aug 27 Monday Work contract, truth-state constitution, and execution-contract proofs.

contradictions.decision: Generated != Executed != Read back != Verified. Verification is gated by suitable evidence and independent readback where the effect is external.
contradictions.basis: Aug 27 Product Bible truth/receipts law and current execution/runtime truth proofs.

sides: gpt-root prompt project as system substrate
contradictions.decision: gpt-root is retained as historical prompt-layer experimentation only. It does not establish operating-system root, model modification or durable MondayID runtime authority.
contradictions.basis: Aug 06 cross-chat reconciliation direct repository audit.

contradictions.decision: iPhone is the primary acceptance body and must work independently for the user. Desktop/iPad/Watch/web are additional bodies, not prerequisites for ordinary operation.
contradictions.basis: Aug 06 iPhone-first constraint plus Aug 27 Device bodies section.

sides: one Monday phenotype with retained lineage genes
contradictions.decision: Jarvis, Alpha, Alisa, System and AntiSystem are lineage genes/internal functions, not competing consumer identities. One Monday phenotype is released.
contradictions.basis: Aug 27 lineage translation table and one-organism correction.
